scope: Phase-2 original density, independent message reading and in-page Quick Entry. Deterministic simulated DOM only; no product/runtime/browser claim.
limitations: Reuses all baseline harness fixtures and limitations.
No CSS variable cascade/layout measurements, rendered size or reflow checks.
Synthetic input/composition/scroll heights do not validate real IME or native editing.
No native Quick Entry window, system shortcuts, account, backend or persistence.

results.title: Initial independent dimensions and accessible selected state
Density changes the specimen attribute without changing the reading axis
All six density/reading combinations keep the other axis and draft
Theme, navigation and conversation reset retain in-page display preferences
Display preferences are page-only even when storage is unavailable
Malformed button choices cannot set unsupported attributes or text
Quick Entry starts closed, empty and independent from the full composer
Open focuses the text target and exposes the correct controlled region
Plain Enter captures locally with selected context and leaves the conversation unchanged
Native form submission is intercepted; repeat/empty submission does not overwrite
Modified Enter combinations never submit and leave native editing unhandled
Composition state suppresses Enter, submit and Escape until compositionend
isComposing and legacy keyCode 229 each protect quick input independently
Escape retains draft/context, restores opener, and reopens without data loss
Dismiss button and keyboard Escape on context both preserve drafts
Quick Entry markup-looking input is a literal text sink
Only latest capture is retained and context snapshots do not mutate retroactively
Clear removes only the last record, retains draft and restores an available focus target
New observation clears capture/draft and restores the full composer focus
Quick capture does not cancel or duplicate an active full-composer generation
Overlength programmatic input is rejected, retained, and recoverable
Auto-height algorithm clamps synthetic scroll heights without resizing the composer
Hidden-panel programmatic submit cannot capture its retained draft
New display and quick-entry interactions remain independent in a narrow media fixture
User Stop before first chunk restores composer focus and does not offer placeholder copying
User Stop after a chunk retains real text and copy action
Passive generation completion does not take focus from another input
Stop in narrow inspector releases inert background before restoring composer focus
Explicit inspector simulation starts focus the composer before their trigger disables
Explicit narrow inspector starts close overlay and release background focus
Explicit retry restores composer focus after its error banner disappears
Passive failure preserves focus on a different active input
